messages:
maria: Quick PSA — before tomorrow's cutoff please keep changelog entries compact: one-line TLDR, optional single bullet for why/impact, and an owner. Example below (copy/paste as needed).

dan: Can you drop the example here? Not sure if my entry counts as compact or needs trimming.

maria: Sure — example format:```
- [console] Fix cost calc for batching (dan)
  TLDR: Reduce over-counting of tokens in batched runs.
  Why: regression after KV cache change caused ~20% token inflation.
  Owner: @dan
  Note: full repro + perf numbers in PR #4219
```

akash: Are we still using component tags? e.g. `[console]` vs `[runtime]` — wanted to be consistent.

maria: Yes, keep 1-2 tags max at start of the TLDR. Use the first primary component.

release-bot: :bell: Reminder — changelog cut in ~6 hours. Please finalize entries or ping a release lead.

sarah: Small ops question — if you have 3 tiny fixes, group under `misc` or list separate lines?

emily: Group as one `misc` entry with comma-separated bullets in the PR body, but changelog should be a single compact line.

dan: Got it. Also, for breaking changes: add `BREAKING:` prefix and one-line migration note, right?

maria: Correct. `BREAKING: <one-line>` then `Migration: <link>` if needed. Keep changelog short, link to docs for details.

akash: Quick ask for reviewers: when doing changelog reviews, check for TLDR clarity + component tag + owner. If unclear, ping author for a 1-line rewrite. :eyes:

dan: Updated my PR (commit 2b3f1c) and trimmed the entry to the example shape. PTAL.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks — I can do a quick sweep after cutoff and tidy obvious formatting issues. If anyone wants me to shorten entries pre-cut, DM me and I'll help.

release-bot: Cutoff passed — locking entries now. If you need an emergency change, file a hotfix and notify #eng-releases with `hotfix-changelog` tag.
